summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the confidential supply-chain data, find hidden launch risks, and build a general recheck-and-act agent product (poller, extraction, reconciliation, supplier emails with approval) plus interview/briefing materials.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses Sunday launch despite an 'all ok' plan (art books overbooked by 72,000, failed statue lot, sleeve rev conflict, game card shortfall). Built a Python/web app with watcher, tracking reconciliation, editable email review, sent-folder sync with duplicate-send guard and drop-drill fixes (292 tests passing), sent supplier follow-ups and an art book order reply, and published briefing/interview docs.

repo: Portal API has only files list, single file and archive.zip; no webhooks. Drops arrive unannounced and replace files under the same name, so change detection must compare SHA-256 checksums.
Sensitive data lives in gitignored data/ and .env; .env.example is committed. Entire only checkpoints when repo files change.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist; claim tasks in PROGRESS.md.
The mailbox is shared by the app, hand-sent mails and a teammate's Pulse console. The app only saw its own sends until the sent-folder sync was added.
Send safety: server only sends to known supplier addresses (supplier_addresses()/known_addresses()); new contacts from JSON profiles require explicit approval before use as targets.
Supplier profile JSON files differ from profile.csv (Pune 'watch', PackRight 'at risk') and were previously only mined for email addresses.
A broad commit can accidentally include uncommitted edits from parallel subagents, producing a HEAD that fails to import (b0cff82 needed supplier_master.py).

code.finding: Shipment status reconciliation precedence: goods receipt, site answer, supplier doc/reply, hand-kept tracker (if newer), system export, other sheets. Highest tracker version then newest file wins.
Syncs sent folder to cases by thread reference, then supplier plus order number, or a uniquely matching part number; powers the 12h duplicate-send guard (409 unless Send anyway).
Compares newer supplier profile JSON against profile.csv and raises cards; was untracked while api.py imported it.
Lucas's branch origin/new-approach sends emails via the shared mailbox without an address allow-list, causing stray emails to Hwaseong and an external Gmail.

workflow: Subagents are effective for long cross-checks (200 order confirmations, 59 scans) and drop rehearsals on a copy of the data.
Rehearse drops on a copied state dir with background loops disabled (ASK_REPLY_POLL=off, ASK_TEAMS=off, ASK_LLM_PROVIDER=none).
Look up real contact names in supplier profiles instead of guessing salutations from email addresses.
